title: Black sand in your gutters
caption:
Black sand in your gutters? That is granule loss.
It ages your shingles fast.
DM us a photo and we will tell you what we see.
ES: ¿Arena negra en las canaletas? Mándanos una foto.
check_with_ae: "DM us a photo": who answers and how fast?

scenes.headline: Black sand in your **gutter**?
scenes.say: Seeing black sand in your gutters after it rains?

scenes.headline: Those are **granules**
scenes.say: Those are granules. They protect your shingles from the Florida sun.

scenes.headline: Losing them **ages** your roof
scenes.say: When they wash off, the shingle bakes and ages fast.

scenes.headline: Look for **3 signs**
scenes.say: Look for three signs. Grit in the gutters, bald patches, and curling edges.

scenes.headline: Never **climb** up there
scenes.say: Do not climb up there. Check from the ground with your phone.

props.reply: Thanks! We will take a look.

scenes.headline: Send us a **photo**
scenes.say: Send us a photo and we will tell you what we see.

scenes.headline: Inspect it **every year**
scenes.say: A yearly inspection catches this early, before it turns into a leak.

scenes.headline: Not sure? **Ask us**
scenes.say: A and E Brothers Roofing. DM us a photo today.
